title: _table_region_index.json -- DAO-owned table-region receipts v0.1
description: P0-8. One `table_region_v1` receipt per derived table. A reference table's `source_regions` used to be the extracting agent's own declaration, enforced downwards (rows inside regions, every region character covered by a row or a header span) but never upwards: nothing established that the declared region was the table's real extent, so a region drawn narrowly hid every row outside it, and a `header_span` with kind `note` hid rows inside it. A receipt here records the extent and the row bands the DAO derived by opening the registered PDF and running a real table detector over it, mapped onto exact offsets in the registered source-text revision. DAO-OWNED: written only by `dao.py register-table-region`. No agent-facing write path may create, change, or delete a receipt -- the file is sealed in dao._PROTECTED_CONTRACT_FILES, so a generic write-contract cannot mint one. Deliberately NOT keyed on table_uid: RT is derived FROM source_regions, so selecting a receipt by table_uid would make the regions authorize the receipt that authorizes the regions.

tables.description: One entry per derived table region. A table absent from this array has no receipt, which blocks a canonical_v1 write and policy_clause_processing finalization -- never a check that is skipped for lack of data.

table_region_receipt.description: One table's DAO-derived extent and row structure. Valid only for the exact pair it names: these raw PDF bytes and this source-text revision. Either moving makes the receipt a true statement about a state that no longer exists, which is why the write gate and finalization re-check both against freshly computed values instead of trusting the recorded ones.

receipt_id.description: Computed by the DAO from source provenance and detector output only (see table_region_provenance.compute_receipt_id) -- never from a caller-supplied value and never from table_uid. Because issuance metadata is excluded from the hash, re-deriving identical bytes yields the identical id, which is what makes re-registration a recognizable no-op rather than a second receipt.

scheme.description: The verification this receipt was issued under. A value this build does not recognize is refused rather than treated as equivalent -- an unknown scheme is not a verified one.

document_id.description: The document whose table this receipt establishes. A reference table citing a receipt issued for a different document is refused: a real receipt for the wrong document is still not provenance for this one.

source_pdf_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the registered raw file, computed by the DAO by reading the file at registration time -- never accepted from the caller and never copied out of the manifest. For a segment this is the PARENT's digest, matching canonical UID identity rules.

source_text_revision_sha256.description: The registered source-text revision (see revision_index.schema.json) whose page bodies the offsets below index into. Revising the text after the receipt was issued makes it stale: the extent was derived against bytes that are no longer current.

segment_derivation_receipt_id.description: For a segment, the P0-6 segment_page_map_v2 derivation whose logical->physical mapping these regions sit on top of; null for a physical document. Recorded so a re-derived page map makes this receipt stale rather than silently re-pointing its regions at different physical pages.

detector.description: The table-detection identity the DAO observed. The profile NAME enters the receipt fingerprint, so retuning what a profile means requires a new profile name and a fresh derivation -- silently changing a detector under a stable name would let two different extents claim the same provenance.

selector.description: What the caller asked for, recorded for audit only. It selects among candidates the DAO found and grants nothing: it can never define, widen or narrow an extent. A selector matching two candidates, or none, issues no receipt at all.

extent.description: The table's full derived extent, one entry per logical page it occupies. A reference table's source_regions must equal this set exactly -- not overlap it, not sit inside it. This is the field that makes a narrow region detectable.

regions.description: Every band the detector found inside the extent, each with the structural kind the DAO derived for it. Extracted rows must map onto the `data_row` bands as a bijection, and a header_span may only cover a band classified non-data -- which is what stops a data row being relabelled `note` to escape coverage.

issued_by.description: The --held-by of the DAO call. Accountability, not authority: it grants nothing, and in particular is never a substitute for the derived geometry.

verification_status.description: Only a fully derived region is recorded. An ambiguous or unmappable layout does not produce a weaker receipt -- it produces no receipt, and the table stays review_required. A future human-approved status would be a separate, authenticated path (see known-gaps.md), never a boolean an agent can set.

derived_region.description: One derived band: where it is in the PDF (bbox), where it is in the registered processed text (offsets + verbatim quote), and what the detector established it to be. Both coordinate systems are required -- the bbox is what the detector actually found, the offsets are what a contract's spans can be compared against, and the page digest ties the offsets to specific page bytes.

page.description: Logical page in the registered source-text revision.

physical_page.description: The physical page of the raw PDF the detector read, resolved through the P0-6 page map for a segment. Recorded so a region's geometry and its text offsets cannot silently refer to different pages.

kind.description: `table_extent` appears only in `extent`. `ambiguous` marks a band the detector could not establish as data or non-data: it is never a coverage exemption -- a table containing one may only be written review_required, and cannot finalize.

quote.description: The exact registered page text at [start_char:end_char], verbatim. Stored so a receipt can be audited without re-reading the revision, and re-verified against the revision at finalization.

page_text_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the whole registered page body (NFC, LF-normalized) this band was located in. Catches a revision whose pointer matches but whose page bytes do not.

bbox.description: The band's rectangle in PDF coordinates, as the detector reported it.

cells.description: The detector's cells for this band, each mapped to exact processed-text offsets. Empty for a band with no resolvable cells.
